prompt:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic social media video, 10 seconds. This is scene 1 of one continuous story, so establish all visual elements clearly and keep them consistent for later continuation scenes. A modern minimalist home-office desk made of medium-dark walnut wood. Soft warm morning sunlight enters from the upper-left side of frame through unseen window blinds, creating subtle diagonal shadows across the desk. The camera is positioned slightly above desk level at a 35-degree downward angle, looking toward the center of the desk. Keep this exact desk, lighting direction, camera orientation, smartphone, papers, coffee mug, and hand appearance consistent throughout all following scenes. At the center of the desk is a modern black Android smartphone lying face-up in portrait orientation. To its left is a matte dark-gray coffee mug. To the right is a small neat black document tray. The desk initially looks perfectly clean. For the first two seconds, nothing happens, only quiet room ambience. Then one paper receipt slides into frame from the right. Another receipt slides in from the left. Then several receipts, invoices, handwritten notes, forms, and envelopes begin sliding rapidly onto the desk from every direction. The amount quickly becomes ridiculous. Papers overlap each other, cover the desk, fall over the phone, and partially surround the coffee mug. Do not show any person, face, body, or animal. Only a single realistic adult human right hand may appear. The hand has natural proportions, short clean nails, no jewelry, and a medium-neutral skin tone. Maintain exactly the same hand appearance throughout every scene. At around second 5, the right hand slowly enters from the bottom-right corner and stops above the mountain of paperwork, as if staring at the ridiculous mess. The hand lifts one tiny receipt from the pile. A warm, confident adult male narrator with a natural conversational voice, around age 30 to 40, neutral international English accent, dry understated comedic delivery says, "Ah yes. Paperwork. Because apparently the year is still 1998." Pause briefly. The hand drops the tiny receipt back onto the enormous pile. The narrator continues, "Let's fix this." At second 8, the hand begins pushing papers aside until the black smartphone underneath becomes visible. The camera slowly pushes closer toward the phone. End the scene with the hand resting beside the partially uncovered smartphone, index finger hovering just above the phone screen, ready to tap it. This exact ending composition must be preserved for the next continuation scene. Audio: realistic paper sliding, paper rustling, subtle room ambience, gentle finger movement sounds. No background music, no musical score, no singing. Visual style: highly realistic, polished modern commercial cinematography, natural motion, subtle comedy, believable physics, detailed paper textures, realistic hands. Important restrictions: no people except the single hand, no faces, no full human bodies, no animals, no extra fingers, no malformed hands, no floating random objects, no illegible paragraphs of AI text, no random brand logos.

Continue directly from the exact final frame of the previous scene. Duration 10 seconds, vertical 9:16. Do not reset the environment. Maintain the exact same walnut desk, warm sunlight from upper-left, dark-gray coffee mug on the left, black document tray on the right, same black Android smartphone, same pile of receipts and documents, same camera direction, same color grading, and exactly the same realistic right hand. The scene begins with the right index finger already hovering above the phone screen exactly where the previous scene ended. The finger taps the phone once. A subtle clean digital activation sound is heard. From the smartphone, a thin glowing cyan rectangular scanning frame rises vertically about 20 centimeters above the phone like a futuristic augmented-reality interface. It should look elegant and believable, not magical fantasy. The holographic scanning frame expands horizontally over the desk. The hand selects one crumpled receipt from the pile and places it flat in front of the phone. A thin cyan scan line travels smoothly from the top edge of the receipt to the bottom. As the scanning line passes over the paper, a perfectly straight clean digital representation of the receipt appears floating above the phone as a simple white document card. Do not attempt to generate lots of tiny readable interface text. Use clean geometric lines, a large document icon, and a large checkmark. The same warm confident adult male narrator from scene 1, age 30 to 40, neutral international English accent, dry understated comedic delivery says, "PaperBeam turns your phone into a document scanner." The hand picks up a second page and places it beside the first. The scanning line passes over it automatically. Another floating digital page joins the first. Then a third. The narrator continues with slightly amused timing, "Receipts, notes, forms... basically everything your desk has been collecting against your will." As he speaks, three or four additional papers slide neatly underneath the holographic scanner one after another, creating a satisfying rhythm. The digital pages above the phone automatically stack into a neat floating multi-page document. Natural paper sounds accompany each movement. Near second 8, the physical paperwork pile is noticeably smaller. The hand gently pushes the newly scanned physical papers toward the black document tray on the right. End the scene with the floating digital document stack hovering above the phone and one messy handwritten note remaining directly in front of the phone. The hand moves toward the handwritten note as the camera subtly pushes closer. This exact final composition must continue into the next scene. Audio: realistic paper sounds, subtle touchscreen tap, clean scanner sound effects, quiet room ambience. No music of any kind.

Continue seamlessly from the exact final frame of the previous scene. Duration 10 seconds, vertical 9:16. Maintain all continuity exactly: same desk, same warm sunlight, same coffee mug position, same document tray, same smartphone position, same camera direction, same hand appearance, same cyan holographic visual language, same warm confident adult male narrator voice, age 30 to 40, neutral international English accent, dry understated comedic delivery. The handwritten note from the previous scene is still directly in front of the smartphone. It contains intentionally messy handwriting, crossed-out lines, arrows, circles, scribbles, and chaotic note-taking. Do not generate important readable sentences on the physical paper; the handwriting should mostly look naturally messy. The right hand lifts the note slightly and rotates it left, then right, as if trying to understand what it says. The hand pauses. The narrator says with completely serious deadpan delivery, "And then there's handwriting." Pause for half a second. The hand rotates the note again. The narrator says, "Apparently this was written by a functioning adult." The hand places the note flat. The index finger taps a large simple OCR symbol in the holographic interface above the smartphone. A cyan scanning beam passes over the handwritten page. As the beam moves downward, individual messy handwritten marks visually lift away from the paper as glowing fragments. The fragments rise into the air, straighten themselves, and reorganize into several clean horizontal digital text lines floating above the phone. Keep the floating digital text mostly abstract or represented by clean horizontal lines rather than long readable generated sentences. A large simple "OCR" label can appear clearly for a moment. The narrator continues, "PaperBeam can extract the text for you." The chaotic scribbles visually transform into a clean organized digital text card. The hand makes a small satisfied finger gesture, almost like saying "finally." At second 8, the handwritten note slides toward the document tray. As it moves away, it reveals a printed document underneath with a clearly visible blank signature line near the bottom. The holographic OCR card gently shrinks back toward the smartphone. End the scene with the printed document centered in front of the phone, its blank signature line clearly visible, and the hand hovering over it. The camera should settle slightly lower and closer to the document, creating a natural setup for signing in the next scene. Audio: paper rustling, subtle hologram sounds, touchscreen tap, quiet office ambience. No music, no musical score, no singing.

Continue seamlessly from the exact final frame of the previous scene. Duration 10 seconds, vertical 9:16. Keep every environmental element identical: same walnut desk, same lighting, same black smartphone, same coffee mug, same document tray, same hand, same camera orientation, same cinematic grade, same warm confident adult male narrator voice, age 30 to 40, neutral international English accent, dry understated comedic delivery. The printed document with the blank signature line remains centered in front of the smartphone. For one second everything is calm. Then a yellow sticky note suddenly slides into frame from the upper-right and lands beside the document. It clearly says "SIGN". A second sticky note falls beside it saying "URGENT". Then another saying "REMINDER". The timing should be comedic but realistic. The right hand stops moving and slowly reacts with annoyed body language alone. Another sticky note lands. The narrator says, "And of course..." Pause. "...someone needs a signature." Another sticky note lands. The narrator continues, "Immediately." The right hand calmly taps the smartphone. A clean holographic signature panel rises above the phone. Instead of showing a detailed fake app screen, show a large simple signature field. The index finger draws a short smooth signature gesture across the holographic panel. A realistic elegant handwritten signature appears. The signature then visually transfers downward from the hologram onto the signature line of the document. A large glowing checkmark appears. At exactly this moment, all the sticky notes slide away from the document as if they have suddenly lost their purpose. The narrator says with dry satisfaction, "Done." Half-second beat. Then he adds, "Before they send reminder number twelve." The hand gently slides the signed document toward the black document tray. As the document moves right, an envelope underneath becomes visible containing a printed QR code and a small product barcode. The phone remains in the middle of the desk. End the scene with the QR-code envelope partially exposed beside the smartphone and the hand beginning to reach toward it. Audio: sticky-note impacts, paper movement, touchscreen tap, subtle signature animation sound, quiet room tone. No background music, no musical sting, no singing.

Continue directly and seamlessly from the exact final frame of the previous scene. Duration 10 seconds, vertical 9:16. Do not reset anything. Maintain the exact same desk, lighting, phone, mug, document tray, hand, camera orientation, color grade, narrator voice, and holographic visual style. The QR-code envelope revealed at the end of the previous scene remains next to the smartphone. The right hand picks up the envelope and places it flat in front of the phone. The same warm confident adult male narrator, age 30 to 40, neutral international English accent, dry understated comedic delivery says, "And because apparently paperwork wasn't enough..." The phone emits a small cyan scanning frame over the QR code. The QR code is recognized and a large simple floating QR icon appears above the phone. The hand rotates the envelope slightly, revealing the barcode. A second scan line passes across the barcode. A clean barcode icon appears next to the QR icon. The narrator finishes, "...it scans QR codes and barcodes too." The hand places the envelope neatly into the black document tray. Now the desk is almost perfectly clean again. Only the smartphone remains in the center. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the transformation from chaos to an organized workspace. Above the phone, several clean holographic icons appear in a simple row: document scan icon, OCR icon, signature icon, QR icon, PDF icon, folder icon. Keep icons large, simple, clean, and visually understandable. Then introduce the privacy payoff. A soft translucent cloud-shaped hologram begins drifting toward the floating documents from the upper-left. Before it reaches them, a large elegant shield-and-lock hologram expands from the smartphone and blocks the cloud. The cloud gently dissolves. The narrator says, "And your documents stay on your device." Small pause. He finishes, "No account. No forced cloud. Just PaperBeam." The floating feature icons smoothly collapse into one elegant central document-and-lock icon above the smartphone. The hand slides the coffee mug slightly closer to the phone and exits naturally from frame. End on a calm clean hero shot of the smartphone centered on the organized walnut desk, warm sunlight across the surface, subtle holographic document-and-lock icon floating above it. Hold the final image for the last one second. Audio: QR scan beep, barcode scan beep, subtle digital shield sound, soft paper movement, quiet room ambience. Absolutely no music, no musical sting, no singing. No faces, no people, no full bodies, no animals. Human hand only. No extra fingers, no malformed hands, no random changing phone design, no random interface text, no unrelated logos.
